evidence.text: The movie is an unofficial remake of hit Kannada movie" Mussanjemaatu".

evidence.title: Achena Prem
evidence.text: Surprisingly the fact that it is a remake of the Kannada movie has not been mentioned either on the Achena Prem's official website or in other reviews/ articles on the internet All Kannada songs from the original have been also retained in the movie.

evidence.text: The song" Kar Mone te ki Swopno Thake" is the Bengali version of Kannada song" Enagali Munde Saagu Nee" and" Tomake Bhebe Mon" is the Bengali version of Kannada song" Ninna Nodalento".

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: Edwin L. Marin (February 21, 1899 – May 2, 1951) was an American film director who directed 58 films between 1932 and 1951, working with Randolph Scott, Anna May Wong, John Wayne, Peter Lorre, George Raft, Bela Lugosi, Judy Garland, Eddie Cantor, and Hoagy Carmichael, among many others.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: Marin was born in Jersey City, New Jersey, and died in Los Angeles, California.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: He was married to actress Ann Morriss.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: They had three children: Denis Anthony, Reese Andrew and Randi Alexandra.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: He studied at the University of Pennsylvania and broke into the industry as an assistant director at MGM.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: He was under contract to MGM for 15 years and RKO for five.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: When he died he was under contract to Warner Bros.
